body: # Equity Market Outlook: Navigating Fast-Moving Markets and Tariff Fears. Our latest Equity Market Outlook dives into key questions that are top of mind: ✅ How can I keep up in fast-moving markets? Our Market Review and Q4 Outlook: Private Markets section highlight's key themes — from liquidity strategies to sector momentum — shaping the path forward. Here’s what investors could consider to help mitigate risks and potentially benefit from global equities: https://bit.ly/3KQfXZM. Global markets continue to demonstrate resilience amid shifting policy, persistent inflation pressures, and evolving correlations across asset classes. Michael Hans, CFA and Citizens Private Wealth’s Office of the CIO have released their Q3 Market Commentary, highlighting equity market strength amidst mixed economic signals. The latest market commentary and outlook for advisers, from our in-house investment experts, is now available. As Farther’s October Market Commentary notes, equities and bonds remain strong year-to-date, and volatility at this stage is well within historical norms. ➡️ Read Julius Baer's Market Outlook as we highlight what investors need to know: https://ow.ly/SKP930sQ2bA #MarketOutlook.

I consult or invest on behalf of a financial institution. ### AI in Asia. We remain constructive on the long-term AI opportunity and continue to identify potential beneficiaries across what we see as a multi-year investment cycle. We see value in broadening our focus to other areas of the global markets and discuss the possibilities in our Q3 Equity Market Outlook. We continue to see scope for ample opportunity ― in both the AI theme and in areas well beyond it across global equity markets. One of the biggest constraints on AI development is energy and the infrastructure needed to deliver it, creating compelling opportunity in the companies that are best placed to both produce this power and get it to where it’s needed. A portion of AI investment from the big U.S. tech companies is flowing to the large Asian makers of the semiconductors needed for AI expansion.
